scope: C# methods over pinned Linux x86-64 Lean IO, BaseIO, EIO and their pure companions. Code is compiled before packaging. Consumers restore an exact NuGet version and call a precompiled assembly.
checks: The ordinary and independently reviewed Journal archives have the same Binding IR and different source and archive digests. Fresh elaboration must accept the real review and reject a type-changed review. At capture, regenerated C# sources agree with the installed files.

A local-only NuGet restore installs Journal and an independently built Clock. The original archive digest and the installed package inventory are checked. The client is relocated; its feed, package cache and project are removed before execution with no build tools on PATH.

Both load orders execute 19 scalar carriers, exact signed/unsigned integers including a 4098-bit value, strict text, independent byte arrays, and all three nested returned/thrown Except cases. Negative and oversized inputs are rejected before the Lean operation can alter a file.

Both load orders observe one native runtime, two component initializations and zero live identities. Declared IO failures remain recoverable. Explicit test-only runtime retirement makes subsequent calls from either package fail without changing the file; a fresh process refuses an altered native component.
buildPolicy: Separate real producer checks rejected a missing filesystem grant, an async selection, and a requested resource lease. None emitted a release directory.
limits: Local .NET 8 SDK 8.0.424 and runtime 8.0.30 / Lean 4.32.2 / Linux x86-64 glibc 2.36 test build; this is not hosted or full-matrix evidence.

This profile covers synchronous direct copied values and returned/nested Except. It does not project Task, streams, callbacks, or resource-valued errors. The observer explicitly retires the runtime; this is not evidence of automatic recovery or poisoning after arbitrary process faults.

reproduce.requirements: The producer needs the pinned LEAN_BRIDGE_LEAN_PREFIX, C compiler and .NET 8 SDK. Set LEAN_BRIDGE_DOTNET if necessary. Replay needs the original three handoffs, retained Program.cs, Audit.cs, acceptance.json and the SDK to build the independent consumer, not Lean or a native compiler.
